planned_release_identity.free_selection_policy: Preserve the existing 20 free questions exactly; DRONE-Q-000101..DRONE-Q-000188 retain their canonical is_free=false values.

execution_preconditions: Before activation, re-read authoritative current main. The preparation_base_main identifies the reviewed pre-preparation baseline; current main is expected to include the merged preparation transition and does not need to equal that SHA.

Every baseline-bound release input must still match its recorded blob SHA. If any bound canonical, registry, source-verification, candidate, released-snapshot, generated-runtime, manifest, or app-asset input changed after preparation, re-audit the drift and re-prepare before activation.
The target review must remain FROZEN at exactly 188 and broad expansion must remain STOP.
Exactly DRONE-Q-000101..DRONE-Q-000188 must remain canonical draft questions with permanent IDs already allocated and registry status used with blank first_used_bank_revision.

All 88 selected expansion questions must retain canonical source-verification evidence matching their current source ID and source version, and validate_bank(check_generated=false) must PASS before activation mutation.

The accepted expansion candidates bound above must remain VERIFIED and exact-bound to their canonical questions; rejected, held, collision, and unallocated candidates must remain outside the release selection.
The existing 100 released question contracts and their original first_used_bank_revision values must remain unchanged before the activation begins.
The historical V0 formal snapshot and validation-generated artifacts must remain untouched.
required_atomic_mutations: Update only DRONE-Q-000101..DRONE-Q-000188 in canonical questions.csv from draft to active and set last_reviewed_at to 2026-08-24; preserve question IDs, versions, units, question text, choices, correct answers, explanations, source bindings, difficulty, importance, is_free flags, validity fields, supersedes IDs, tags, and internal notes unless a validator-proven metadata correction is strictly required.

Set first_used_bank_revision for exactly DRONE-Q-000101..DRONE-Q-000188 to drone-second-class-v2-release-2026-08-24; preserve DRONE-Q-000001..DRONE-Q-000100 historical first-use revisions and every retired-ID tombstone/replacement invariant.

Extend released_questions.json deterministically from the existing 100 immutable release contracts to exactly 188, appending exact release snapshots for DRONE-Q-000101..DRONE-Q-000188 without rewriting the protected answer contracts of DRONE-Q-000001..DRONE-Q-000100.
Change bank.json to the planned bank_revision and content_as_of only after the selected canonical/registry/release snapshot mutations are staged together.
Regenerate the canonical runtime bank and manifest deterministically from the 188 active questions, then copy the generated runtime byte-identically to the Drone app question-bank asset.

Transition only the accepted, exact-bound expansion candidate rows corresponding to DRONE-Q-000101..DRONE-Q-000188 from VERIFIED to RELEASED after canonical active state, release snapshot, first-use revision, runtime membership, and validate_bank(check_generated=true) all prove RELEASED evidence; preserve rejected/collision/non-selected candidate states.
Update release-fact documentation and regression assertions only where the 188 release makes existing 100-question release facts stale; do not broaden product scope.
prohibited_mutations: No new permanent question IDs and no ID reuse, renumbering, retirement, or replacement changes.
No question-content, choice, correct-answer, explanation, source-locator, source-version, or semantic-collision adjudication changes as part of activation.
No activation of any candidate outside DRONE-Q-000101..DRONE-Q-000188.
No change to the existing 20-question free selection.
No mutation of validation/formal_snapshot or historical V0 evidence.
No partial update of released/runtime state on main and no direct edit of generated artifacts without deterministic regeneration.
verification_gates: Validate all four expansion batches and prove every selected candidate reaches RELEASED only from evidence-backed production state.
Run canonical Question Bank validation before generation and validate_bank(check_generated=true) after regeneration; both must PASS.

Prove canonical active count, released snapshot count, generated runtime count, and app runtime asset count are all exactly 188 with stable IDs DRONE-Q-000001..DRONE-Q-000188 and no duplicates or gaps.
Prove source verification remains complete for every active question and current source versions match the source registry.
Prove registry first-use history is unchanged for DRONE-Q-000001..DRONE-Q-000100, set exactly once to the planned revision for DRONE-Q-000101..DRONE-Q-000188, and remains protected for retired IDs.
Prove generated runtime and the bundled app asset are byte-identical and the manifest reports question_count=188 and free_question_count=20.
Run the repository-required GitHub Actions, including KOMADEKI Autopilot State and Quiz Apps CI, and require all relevant jobs to PASS with no unresolved P0/P1 finding before merge.
rollback_and_partial_state_protection: Perform activation on one branch/PR from a revalidated current-main baseline; main must remain at 100/100/100 until the complete activation PR passes audit and CI.
Abort activation and re-prepare if any bound source/candidate/canonical/release/runtime input has drifted or if current contracts/target state invalidate this preparation.
Never persist a first_used_bank_revision for the 88 selected IDs without the matching active canonical rows and expanded released snapshot in the same activation PR.
Never merge generated/runtime changes without the canonical, registry, release-snapshot, candidate-lifecycle, and app-asset changes that make the 188 release internally consistent.
On any validation, audit, or CI failure, repair the activation branch or abandon it; do not advance machine state or mutate main partially.
